create_ransac_regressor: create a RANSACRegressor to fit a robust linear model robust to outlier data points
fit_ransac_model: fit a RANSACRegressor with training data X and target y using the RANSAC algorithm
predict_with_ransac: predict target values using a fitted RANSACRegressor and its learned inlier model
score_ransac_predictions: score a fitted RANSACRegressor by comparing predicted values against true target values
configure_ransac_parameters: configure RANSACRegressor with custom estimator, min_samples, residual_threshold, and max_trials parameters
